name: figure01_ross_response
caption: Synthetic angular response, not measured imagery or a fitted correction. Same color scale within each figure. Relative azimuth zero is backscatter. Both kernels are zero at double nadir; the dense model is not sparse reciprocal. Upper-hemisphere support is 0 <= zenith < 90 degrees; displaying 0–80 degrees is not an empirical validation domain.

name: figure03_nadir_invariance
caption: Controlled geometry at solar zenith 37.412113 degrees and exact zero view zenith. The historical kernel retained cos(relative azimuth) where a phase-angle dependence was required, along with incorrect crown and overlap terms. Constant verified curves are the required invariance, not evidence that a fixed view can support three coefficients.

name: figure04_neon_geometry
caption: Native source row/column orientation is preserved; gray denotes invalid source/geometry. Display arrays are deterministic native point samples (NEON stride 4, Goldhill stride 6); quantitative ranges, maxima and QR/SVD use every retained native pixel. Scene solar zenith is used for both historical and current comparisons. Goldhill views remain placeholders and are never invented; source alpha is not rewritten. A narrower color range in the old Goldhill map exposes tiny artificial variation, not comparable physical signal amplitude.

name: figure06_design_singular_values
caption: Tall-skinny QR followed by SVD on the full native angular design [1,K_Ross,K_Li]. NEON rank 3 and conditioning are numerical geometry diagnostics, not proof of calibrated surface normalization across heterogeneous pixels. Goldhill rank 1 implies infinite mathematical condition number; its tiny numerical trailing singular values depend on floating-point accumulation and must not be interpreted as recovered angles. Historical Goldhill rank 2 is manufactured by the defective kernel and remains unsupported.

name: figure07_reference_errors
caption: Expected values are evaluated by an independent scalar arbitrary-precision implementation of published equations; no SpectralBridge function generates them. Grazing geometries amplify input-angle representation error, so tests use a documented relative tolerance. The external pinned C++ Ross and nonreciprocal dense functions are separately executed, with an explicit reciprocal conversion; they are not assumed interchangeable without that conversion. The epsilon plot floor changes no reported errors.

name: figure08_kernel_distributions
caption: Histograms use the compact native-point display sample; complete native min/max/mean/standard deviation are in real_geometry_validation.json. Goldhill constant fields use single-value lines. Narrow old Goldhill variation is numerical artifact, not an independent viewing population. Counts describe spatial samples and are not empirical BRDF replicate counts.
